findings.headline: Service template prerequisite was never seeded
findings.rootCause: The scenario seeded Service records, but the Settings → Services page lists service templates. The Autonoma Service factory creates estimate/project services named “Autonoma test service,” and the run metadata shows no ServiceTemplate records were provisioned. With an empty service-template list, the UI correctly rendered “None yet,” so the test could not click “Asphalt - R&R Driveway.”
findings.whatHappened: The agent authenticated, clicked Services in the sidebar, and reached the Services settings page. The services table stayed empty with “None yet,” so it never opened “Asphalt - R&R Driveway” or the notes modal. prior_runs shows this test has never passed or run before, so the plan/scenario were unvalidated.

evidence.detail: No successful baseline exists; this is a first-generation/unvalidated test run.
The run reached the Services settings page, but the service-template table was empty and showed the empty state rather than the expected row.
Scenario provisioning reported seeded project/estimate services, but no service-template records.
The Settings Services page renders an empty state when no service templates are present.
The Autonoma Service factory requires estimate/project linkage, so it creates project services rather than settings service templates.
Seeded Service rows use a different hardcoded name from the row expected by the test.
The PR also makes the old Edit Notes path unavailable for override service templates, but the run never reached this behavior.

findings.headline: Scenario user lacks organization membership
findings.rootCause: The scenario seeded an Organization and Tenant, but the seeding path shown in apps/autonoma/factories.ts:235-263 only attaches users to tenants, not to user_organizations. The organization switcher renders only organizations returned through userOrgs in apps/chrome/user_dropdown.tsx:55-72, so the required “Acme Demo Org” option was absent. The run remained in org-owned tenant context, where apps/settings/service_templates/list_view.tsx:66-75 hides “New Service,” blocking the test before the notes code could run.
findings.whatHappened: The run loaded the app and reached Settings → Services, but stayed in tenant context showing “Acme Paving North” and an empty “None yet” services table. It never created “Custom Paving Service,” never opened the notes modal, and never saw “Service saved.” There are no prior runs, so this test has no validated passing baseline.

evidence.detail: Baseline shows this was a first-generation, never-validated test.
The video showed the run never reached service creation or notes editing.
The Autonoma User factory seeds tenant membership data but does not create a user_organizations membership.
The organization dropdown only renders organizations from userOrgs, so without user_organizations membership the planned “Acme Demo Org” option is absent.
The app fetches userOrgs from the user_organizations table.
In org-owned tenant context, the Services list hides the New Service button, matching the run’s block before the PR-touched notes flow.

findings.headline: Annual project missing from Sales Calendar seed data
findings.rootCause: The written plan depends on a Sales Calendar-visible project named `Annual Sealcoating`, but the live seeded data exposed only other sidebar projects and no Annual match. The Sales Calendar queue in `apps/schedule/components/sales_calendar_project_queue.tsx:48-68` queries only `lead` and `estimating` projects and filters the returned list, while `apps/schedule/components/project_search.tsx:40-55` explains why the static `Filter: Annual` option can appear even when no actual project exists.
findings.whatHappened: The run reached Sales Calendar, showed `Parking Lot Resurfacing`, and applied the `Filter: Annual` option. After filtering, the sidebar displayed the normal `Nothing to schedule` empty state and `Annual Sealcoating` never appeared. `prior_runs` shows this test has never passed before, so there is no validated baseline tying the failure to this PR.

evidence.detail: Baseline shows this is a first-run/unvalidated test rather than a proven regression.
The run reached Sales Calendar and the sidebar initially contained other projects, but not the expected Annual project.
Typing Annual produced only the static filter option, not a seeded project match.
The observed `Nothing to schedule` message is the normal empty-state rendering for an empty Sales Calendar sidebar.
Sales Calendar only lists lead/estimating projects from the project query and hides already-scheduled projects when not searching, so the scenario must seed a matching eligible project.
The project search component always adds a static `Filter: <query>` option before real project matches, explaining why `Filter: Annual` appeared even with no `Annual Sealcoating` project.
